dates: ((b. Hampstead 1875/6-1953)
---

contributor to MP (1897)

Daughter of the Rev.Michael Rosenthal, Vicar of St. Mark's Aldgate, she published other religious works and hymns; and married Canon William Moore (d. 1943); she was editor of Mothers in Council until 1950.
